page_title: EIN 2-2 AUG | Eintracht Frankfurt v Augsburg 07/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a yellow card from the referee for dissent.
90+5' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Bastian Dankert ignores the protests.

90+3' Nediljko Labrovic is a nightmare for the offensive players! Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) meets a cross on the edge of the penalty area, takes a good first touch and fires a rocket of a shot towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper produces a wonderful save.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' The substitution has been made. Igor Matanovic (Eintracht Frankfurt) has replaced Hugo Ekitike.
88' Oscar Hojlund (Eintracht Frankfurt) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
84' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
81' Neat link-up play between Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) and Omar Marmoush, but Nediljko Labrovic reads the game well and the move breaks down.
80' Jess Thorup decides to make a substitution. Marius Wolf will be replaced by Maximilian Bauer (Augsburg).
79' The substitution is prepared. Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Phillip Tietz.
79' The attendance for today's match is 58000.
79' Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) is penalised for a foul. Bastian Dankert had a clear view and blows his whistle. Augsburg have a free kick.
78' The linesman raises his flag. Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) is adjudged offside.
78' Eintracht Frankfurt enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

74' 2 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) tries his luck from the edge of the box and his shot takes a deflection and goes past the stranded Nediljko Labrovic. He makes it 2:2.
73' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) as he is replaced by Can Yilmaz Uzun.
72' Substitution. Oscar Hojlund has come on for Mahmoud Dahoud (Eintracht Frankfurt).
72' Substitution. Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes his way off the pitch and Jean-Matteo Bahoya comes on as his replacement.
71' 1 - 2 Goal! Samuel Essende (Augsburg) seizes on the loose ball after a huge error from Kevin Trapp and finds the back of the net from inside the box. 1:2.

71' Kevin Trapp makes a brilliant save! Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His effort goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by the keeper!
69' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
67' We are about to witness a subsitution. Robert Gumny (Augsburg) for Henri Koudossou.
67' Jess Thorup prepares a substitution. Elvis Rexhbecaj is replaced by Arne Maier (Augsburg).
64' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt).
63' Bastian Dankert sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
62' Wait! Referee Bastian Dankert has indicated he is going to review the Augsburg goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
60' 1 - 1 Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
55' 1 - 0 GOAL! Ansgar Knauff meets a cross inside the box and heads the ball across the goal, where Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) lurks and pokes it into the back of the net. 1:0.
55' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.

53' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
52' He should have scored! Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
48' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

48' A pass lands at the feet of Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. Now Eintracht Frankfurt have a corner.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Dino Toppmoller gives a chance to Nathaniel Brown and Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) is off.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+7' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+6' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
45+6' Bastian Dankert has a clear sight and sees a foul from Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt). Augsburg have been awarded a free kick.
45+5' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) commits a foul during an attacking move. Augsburg are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
45+4' Eintracht Frankfurt are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
45+1' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
45+1' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Nediljko Labrovic has no trouble gathering it.
45' We will have 6 min. of added time.
45' The game is interrupted as Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) is flagged offside.
44' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball. Augsburg are awarded a free kick.
41' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Bastian Dankert blows his whistle for a foul. Augsburg win a free kick.
41' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.

40' Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.
40' The linesman signals that Samuel Essende (Augsburg) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
38' Henri Koudossou (Augsburg) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
34' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Augsburg.
28' The game is interrupted now, Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
28' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
27' Frank Onyeka (Augsburg) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

23' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg.
23' Eintracht Frankfurt seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

22' Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Bastian Dankert blows for a foul. Augsburg win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
20' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) heads on.
16' Rough tackle by Mahmoud Dahoud (Eintracht Frankfurt). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Augsburg.
13' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
12' Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) was probably a bit loose with his words to Bastian Dankert, who decides to show him a yellow.
7' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play. Eintracht Frankfurt will take a throw-in.
6' Samuel Essende (Augsburg) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Eintracht Frankfurt.
1' Bastian Dankert shows the yellow card to Keven Schlotterbeck (Augsburg) for a heavy challenge.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Augsburg will kick the game off.
Bastian Dankert is introduced as the referee for today's match.
